items.html: And behold, we have now explained how Adam HaRishon takes from all of this world, and also that his body was in the length of the expansion of the three worlds — Beria, Yetzira, Assiya — and it is all one. And now the first aspect has been explained: how the worlds were at the time Adam HaRishon was created. And we have explained how his head and throat were within the Garden of Eden, and his body and feet in the rest of the world.
